description: This file contains shell functions for managing and modifying MTD (Memory Technology Device) partitions specific to I-O DATA devices manufactured by MSTC. It includes functions to prepare environment failure, read/write bytes to MTD devices, and set flags in MTD devices, primarily for device configuration and maintenance tasks.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_prepare_fail
methods.description: Handles failure in environment check/prepare steps by notifying the user, unmounting all filesystems, and rebooting the system.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_rw_byte
methods.description: Reads or writes a single byte from/to an MTD device at a specified offset. If a value is provided, it writes; otherwise, it reads.

methods.name: iodata_mstc_set_flag
methods.description: Sets a specific flag in an MTD device for MSTC devices by reading the current value, validating it, and writing the new value if different.
